wikitext.*: {{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2020–21 |team=Wright State Raiders |sport=Basketball |image= Wright State Raiders logo.png |image_size=200 |conference=Horizon League |division= |short_conf=Horizon |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=18–6 |conf_record=16–4 |head_coach=[[Scott Nagy]] |hc_year = 5th |assoc_coach=Brian Cooley |asst_coach2=Sharif Chambliss |asst_coach3=[[Clint Sargent]] |stadium=[[Nutter Center]] |champion= Horizon League regular season co-champions |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2020–21 Horizon League men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 Wright State Raiders men's basketball team''' represented [[Wright State University]] in the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Raiders, led by fifth-year head coach [[Scott Nagy]], played their home games at the [[Nutter Center]] in [[Fairborn, Ohio]] as members of the [[Horizon League]]. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Wright State Raiders men's basketball team|Raiders]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 25–7, 15–3 in Horizon League play to be regular season Horizon League champions. They lost in the semifinals of the [[2020 Horizon League men's basketball tournament|Horizon League tournament]] to [[2019–20 UIC Flames men's basketball team|UIC]]. As regular season league champions who failed to win their league tournament, they received an automatic bid to the [[2020 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]]. However, the NIT, and all other postseason tournament, were cancelled amid the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]]. == Roster == {{CBB roster/Header|year=2020|team=Wright
